question: How often can the finalized ReelRank model place a participant-selected title first on a genuine SM-RS recommendation list?
unit: Every genuine ten-title SM-RS 2.0 recommendation display. Empty selected sets count as misses. Primary metric first-position hit, secondary nDCG@10, Precision@5, first-five hit and position of first pick. Individual lists may have more than one pick.
features: Timestamped prior offers and selections, publisher ImplicitMF item factors, catalog and rating statistics, and six published recommendation-engine ranks. Current displayed order and labels are excluded from the scoring features.
method: Fit a viewer-specific regularized discriminant of clicked versus previously offered item vectors; combine its score with positive-minus-exposure affinities, field-level neighbor support, group-level catalog embedding descriptors, and existing features. Separate all-prior evidence from recommendation-round-only evidence. Learn population ranking from training participants only.
controls: The six published recommendation engines, the recorded display order, and a supervised LightGBM LambdaMART model fitted to the same features and outcomes.
development: Use the original 86 development participants exclusively. Four GroupKFold folds. Candidate blends of standardized within-list linear choice margin and boosted logit 25%, 50%, 75%, 100%; fully augmented descriptors. Fixed histogram boosted models (180 trees, 12 leaves, L2 10) and list-balanced conditional logit. Selection by highest mean first-slot hit, ties nDCG, then smaller tree fraction. Source and protocol hash frozen before scoring the known 349-person comparison dataset.
check: Evaluate 5,510 lists from 349 participants distinct from development, plus five participant-disjoint folds over 6,892 lists from 435 people. Use 5,000 participant-cluster bootstrap draws for fixed-prediction contrasts and independently regrade from raw publisher data. This is a retrospective evaluation on released logs.
inputs: MovieLens 25M, Goodbooks-10k and released SM-RS checkpoint/table hashes as in the prior catalog model. The movie ratings are input features, not test outcomes.
